title: Consistent CutPINNs for Elliptic PDEs on Curved Level-Set Domains
summary: We propose \emph{Consistent CutPINN}, a framework for partial differential equations posed on bounded curved domains defined implicitly by a $\C^2$ level-set function, $Ω= \{\varphi < 0\}$. In this paper we develop the framework for second-order elliptic problems in two dimensions. The standard PINN loss penalises the boundary mismatch in $L^2(\partialΩ)$, but $L^2(\partialΩ)$ does not control the $H^{1/2}(\partialΩ)$ trace norm that appears in the $H^1(Ω)$ energy estimate.
